headline: DeepSeek keeps the top spot while a debut and three exits reshuffle the leaderboard
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still holds No. 1 at 29.8% of tokens, and DeepSeek as a provider sits at 40.2%. Further down, particle-1 debuts at No. 32, while gpt-6-luna-pro, qwen3.7-flash and gemini-3.1-flash-lite drop off the board.
highlights: meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-20260902 made the biggest one-day climb on the board, up eight places to No. 13.
Tencent's tencent/hy4-20261104 holds No. 2 at 7.8% of tokens.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Tencent, hold 48.8% between them, and the top three reach 55.4%.
Three newcomers appeared today: particle-ai/particle-1-20261027:free at No. 32, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403 at No. 42, and thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small-20261107 at No. 49.
